messages.subject: Problem installing Deducer on Mac-Sierra
parts:
Hello!
I am trying to install Deducer but I get this answer bacK

Warning: unable to access index for repository http://cran.es.r-project.org/src/contrib:
  no fue posible abrir la URL 'http://cran.es.r-project.org/src/contrib/PACKAGES'

Warning: unable to access index for repository http://cran.es.r-project.org/bin/macosx/el-capitan/contrib/3.4:
  no fue posible abrir la URL 'http://cran.es.r-project.org/bin/macosx/el-capitan/contrib/3.4/PACKAGES'

Warning message:
packages ‘JGR’, ‘Deducer’, ‘DeducerExtras’ are not available (for R version 3.4.3) 

Please, help!
Thanks
David

messages.author: 30dc0c001c553eb0
messages.subject: Re: Problem installing Deducer on Mac-Sierra
parts:
Deducer 0.7-9 does work with R 3.4.3, JGR and rjava on macOs High Sierra and Sierra. I can confirm that.
Perhaps tick dependencies when installing or install dependent packages beforehand.
The warning may indicate that the repository is not set correctly.
Go to r preferences, start up and check where the url points to. if empty select a server.

Best wishes
Rudolf
